caption:
For percent change, divide by the old number.

(new − old)/old × 100%. $40 → $52 is 12/40 = 30%, not 12/52 ≈ 23%. It's not on the reference sheet.

Save this for test day.
tiktok_caption: For percent change, divide by the old number: $40 → $52 is a 30% increase.

youtube.title: SAT Percent Change: Always Divide by the Original
youtube.description: The percent change formula isn't on the SAT reference sheet. Worked example: $40 to $52 is 12/40 = a 30% increase.
